title: Daily Workout · November 6
note: 55-minute workout: maintain 6 × 90-second conversational jog intervals, followed by controlled upper-body, glute, and core work. Keep groin and back movements pain-free; reduce intensity or skip any movement that causes discomfort.

items.name: Standing calf stretch
items.instructions: Keep back heel down and stretch gently.

items.name: Butterfly stretch
items.instructions: Sit tall with soles together; do not force knees downward.

items.name: Seated spinal twist
items.instructions: Rotate gently through the upper back; avoid twisting into pain.

items.name: Supine figure-four stretch
items.instructions: Keep the movement gentle; skip if it pulls on the groin.

items.name: Easy warm-up
items.instructions: Build gradually to a comfortable brisk walk.

items.name: Jog interval
items.instructions: Keep a conversational effort; walk instead if groin, back, or knee discomfort develops.

items.name: Recovery walk
items.instructions: Recover until breathing is comfortable.

items.name: Cool-down
items.instructions: Gradually lower speed and finish comfortably.

items.name: Dumbbell floor press
items.instructions: Use a manageable weight, keep shoulders controlled, and exhale during the press.

items.name: Supported dumbbell rows
items.instructions: Support torso on a stable surface; keep spine neutral.

items.name: Bodyweight glute bridges
items.instructions: Squeeze glutes at the top without arching your lower back.

items.name: Dumbbell biceps curls
items.instructions: Keep elbows near your sides and avoid swinging.

items.name: Side planks
items.detail: 3 min · 2 × 30 sec each side, with rest
items.instructions: Use knees-down variation if needed; stop if groin discomfort appears.

items.name: Dead bugs
items.instructions: Move slowly and keep lower back comfortable; shorten leg reach if needed.

items.name: Suitcase carries
items.instructions: Walk tall with a moderate dumbbell and avoid leaning.

items.name: Bird dogs
items.instructions: Extend opposite arm and leg without rotating hips or arching back.
